lines: Ayomanor's usage has jumped lately. He played 83% of snaps over his last 3 games versus 68% on the season, and his target share rose to 21% from 13%.
He saw 7.3 targets per game over the last 3 games, up from 4.0 for the season, and averaged 8.9 PPR points per game versus 5.9.
Week 11 is at DAL, which allows the 7th-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said Ayomanor is a trusted target on key downs.
